about:
Cope Plastics Inc operates a fabrication and distribution branch in Fargo, North Dakota, supported by its headquarters in Alton, Illinois. The Fargo facility sits about four miles from Hector International Airport and serves as a regional hub for custom plastic fabrication and material supply.

The branch runs advanced CNC equipment — saws, routers, and drills — to produce custom plastic parts, prototypes, and cut-to-size components. Its 7,000-square-foot warehouse stocks a range of engineering plastics including sheets, rods, and tubes in materials such as ACM, acrylic, HDPE, nylon, polycarbonate, polyurethane, and UHMW. The company also fabricates specialized components like pistons, thrust washers, rollers, bushings, and boom pads for industrial equipment.

Cope Plastics serves industries including fluid handling, food and beverage, construction, mining operations, material handling, and safety and security. Customers range from food-processing plants needing lubricant-free rollers to mining operations using nylon sheaves for forklifts and crane boom pads. The company also supplies conduit duct spacers, ground protection mats, and outrigger pads for construction and utility applications.

The company emphasizes a streamlined manufacturing process and rigorous quality control to minimize lead times, distinguishing itself from standard plastic distributors by offering USA-made fabricated parts alongside stocked materials. Local delivery is available on qualifying orders.
